mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear and the temperature is 86 degrees near Verona City Hall.

The City of Verona is offering a 100 dollar rebate for residents who install high-efficiency toilets, while also managing the Verona Cemetery on North Main Street where plots are available to anyone regardless of residency.

We have plenty going on with Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and Hop Haus Trivia all taking place today, followed by more live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In police news, a hit-and-run crash occurred on July 26 near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane, resulting in the driver being cited for an improper left turn.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Caramel Turtle, and the shop is open until 10 PM. You can also visit the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park today from 12:30 PM to 4:30 PM.
